module: Node "Get AI Mode" (color ai, repeat_p_duration). Reads the current AI mode of a vehicle. Input: vehId (no value = player). Output: aiMode (string). The value arrives asynchronously: the vehicle runs a command that calls the node back on the game engine side.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: Sends the getCmd command to the vehicle and publishes the last received mode on aiMode (the value is therefore at least one frame late).

getCmd.desc: Builds the Lua command executed on the vehicle side: reads ai.getState().mode and calls n:getAIMode(mode) back on this node via core_flowgraphManager.getManagerGraphNode.

getAIMode.desc: Callback called from the vehicle with the AI mode; stores it in returnedMode.

mode.desc: AI mode of the vehicle (e.g. manual, disabled, random...).
